fullContentHtml:
JPU UG 1st Merit List 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Jai Prakash University (JPU), Chapra has released the 1st merit list for the Graduation / Under Graduate/ Degree Course (B.A, B,.Com, B.Sc) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme on the official website of the JPU. The applications for JPU UG Admission Online Form 2026 were accepted from 16 May 2026 to 10 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their JPU UG 1st Merit List 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 May 2026
  • Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 June 2026
  • 1st Merit List : 22 June 2026
  • Admission Start Date : 23 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 500/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan, E Wallet, Cash Card Fee Mode Only.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is JPU UG 1st Merit List 2026?

JPU UG 1st Merit List 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 10 June 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://www.jpv.ac.in/

How to download notification?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
